name_full: Political Networks Conference 2026
notes: 19th Annual Political Networks Conference at Oddfellows Hall, University of Manchester - first edition held in Europe. Formerly branded PolNet-PaCSS (2025); the 2026 edition reverted to plain PolNet. Abstract submissions closed April 22, 2026 at 11:59 pm BST; decisions May 9, 2026. Partnership with APSA Political Networks Section, ECPR, and INSNA.

name_full: Joint Call for Workshop Proposals 2027 (ACL, EMNLP, EACL, NAACL, COLING)
notes: Single joint call covering workshops at EACL 2027 (Athens, Mar 9-14), COLING 2027 (Macau, May 9-14), NAACL 2027 (San Francisco, Jun 1-5), ACL 2027 (Kyoto, Aug 17-22), and EMNLP 2027 (Mexico/Central America, early Nov). There will NOT be a second call for workshops this cycle. Max 4 pages (2 main proposal + 2 organizer/committee info), LaTeX template. Notification October 2, 2026.

name_full: The Web Conference 2027 (Workshops)
notes: Workshop proposals. Proposal notification October 12, 2026. Workshops held May 10-11, 2027. Workshop paper submission January 4, 2027; notification February 1, 2027; final versions February 16, 2027.

name_full: The Web Conference 2027 (Tutorials)
notes: Tutorial proposals (deadline extended). Half-day (up to 3 hours), lecture-style or hands-on; proposal up to 4 pages incl. references. Notification January 25, 2027. Tutorials held May 10-11, 2027. Final versions due February 16, 2027.

name_full: The Web Conference 2027 (Short Papers: Abstracts Due)
notes: Short paper abstracts. Papers due November 16, 2026. 4 pages including references and appendix. Notification January 4, 2027; final versions January 31, 2027.

name_full: The Web Conference 2027 (Short Papers: Papers Due)
notes: Short papers. Abstracts due November 9, 2026. 4 pages including references and appendix. Notification January 4, 2027; final versions January 31, 2027.

name_full: The Web Conference 2027 (Demonstrations)
notes: Demo submissions. Max 4 pages incl. references; single-blind; Companion Proceedings; in-person presentation required. Notification January 4, 2027; final versions January 31, 2027.

name_full: ACM Conference on Computer-Supported Cooperative Work and Social Computing
notes: CSCW uses a rolling, journal-style submission model with no fixed deadlines. To present, a paper must be accepted at PACM HCI/CSCW or ToCHI (if within CSCW scope) before the program is set; later acceptances receive a slot at CSCW 2028, and authors may also request to defer. Five paper tracks: Design/Theory, Mixed Methods, Qualitative, Quantitative, Systems. Held at the Loews Philadelphia Hotel. Other participation tracks (workshops, posters, doctoral consortium) to be posted. Questions: chairs2027@cscw.acm.org.

name_full: International AAAI Conference on Web and Social Media 2027
notes: Poster submissions (work-in-progress, preliminary findings). Only accepted in the January 2027 (Round 3) submission window. Up to 5 pages excluding checklist; page 5 may contain only references. AAAI two-column format, double-blind, no revise-and-resubmit. Notification March 15, 2027. Published in the ICWSM proceedings.

name_full: International AAAI Conference on Web and Social Media 2027
notes: Demo submissions (interactive demonstrations of tools, systems, or applications). Only accepted in the January 2027 (Round 3) submission window. Up to 3 pages excluding checklist; single-blind review. Notification March 15, 2027.

name_full: International AAAI Conference on Web and Social Media 2027
notes: Workshop proposals, submitted via email (not PCS). Only accepted in the January 2027 (Round 3) submission window. Binary accept/reject decision; notification March 15, 2027. Workshop papers appear in the separate ICWSM Workshop Proceedings.

name_full: International AAAI Conference on Web and Social Media 2027
notes: Tutorial proposals, submitted via email (not PCS). Only accepted in the January 2027 (Round 3) submission window. Binary accept/reject decision; notification March 15, 2027. Tutorials are not published in any proceedings.

name_full: Cambridge Disinformation Summit
notes: Theme: 'Incentives and power infrastructure that support or amplify malign cognitive influence and disinformation campaigns.' Full papers only (no abstracts or proposals); English or with full English translation; no format or length requirements. Priority for newer working papers; any discipline or method. Reviewed by an interdisciplinary scientific committee. £35 submission fee (need-based waivers via CFRA@jbs.cam.ac.uk). Deadline 23:59 GMT; notification by end of December 2026. Hosted by Cambridge Judge Business School.

name_full: International School and Conference on Network Science
notes: Hosted by SynoSys at TU Dresden. One-page abstract (text, one mandatory figure with caption, references) using the official NetSci 2027 LaTeX template, submitted as PDF via eventclass. Contributed talks (12 min + 3 min Q&A) or posters (A0 portrait); PC makes the final assignment. Must be presented in person; one abstract per presenting author. Notification January 15, 2027. Satellites/School May 17-18; main conference May 18-21.

name_full: CHI 2027 Digital Experience Competition
notes: Submissions due December 4, 2026 (AoE). Notifications end of January 2027. Held at the David L. Lawrence Convention Center.

name_full: Computation + Journalism Symposium 2026
notes: Up to 5 pages excluding references, 2-column ACM template, not anonymized; short abstract, keywords, and a ~100-word generative AI disclosure required. Proceedings are posted online but non-archival. Theme: 'News Beyond the Newsroom' (news influencers and creators, evolving audiences, AI agents and journalism, synthetic media). Submit via EasyChair; decisions August 10, 2026. Hosted by Northwestern University.

name_full: Computation + Journalism Symposium 2026
notes: Contributed talks: abstract of 250 words or fewer with name, affiliation, email, title, and description; any reasonable file format. The committee assigns the presentation format (talk or poster). Theme: 'News Beyond the Newsroom' (news influencers and creators, evolving audiences, AI agents and journalism, synthetic media). Submit via EasyChair; decisions August 10, 2026. Hosted by Northwestern University.

name_full: Computation + Journalism Symposium 2026
notes: Workshop proposals: abstract of 250 words or fewer covering impact, previous iterations, space/technical needs, and organizers (organizers not counted). Theme: 'News Beyond the Newsroom' (news influencers and creators, evolving audiences, AI agents and journalism, synthetic media). Submit via EasyChair; decisions August 10, 2026. Hosted by Northwestern University.

name_full: CHI 2027 Journals Track
notes: For authors of articles accepted to ACM TOCHI or ACM TSC (normally accepted between November 2025 and October 2026); other HCI journals may be accommodated by contacting tpc@chi2027.acm.org. No further review. Notification January 28, 2027.

name_full: CHI 2027 Student Mentoring Program: Dissertation Research Roundtable
notes: Preference for mid-stage PhD students. Single-author (no advisors as co-authors), non-anonymized. Up to 4-page research description (single-column extended abstract, excl. references) plus benefits statement. Notification February 18, 2027. Accepted work published as an Extended Abstract in the ACM DL. Part of the restructured doctoral consortium.

name_full: International AAAI Conference on Web and Social Media 2027 - Dataset Papers
notes: Dataset papers presenting novel datasets that benefit the research community. Only accepted in the January 2027 (Round 3) submission window. 2-10 pages excluding checklist; single-blind review; a DOI indexing the dataset is required. Notification March 15, 2027.

name_full: International AAAI Conference on Web and Social Media 2027 - Social Science and Sociophysics Track
notes: Same deadlines and requirements as full papers (also accepted in the May and September 2026 rounds); this is the final window for ICWSM 2027. Papers are not included in the proceedings, though abstracts are published. Notification March 15, 2027.

name_full: The Web Conference 2027 (Industry Track: Abstracts Due)
notes: Industry paper abstracts, submitted via the same OpenReview portal as research papers (select Long/Short Paper and set "Industry Paper" to Yes). Papers due October 25. Double-blind. Results December 15, 2026; rebuttal December 15-20; notification January 4, 2027; final versions January 31, 2027. Published in the main proceedings.

name_full: The Web Conference 2027 (Industry Track: Papers Due)
notes: Industry papers. 8 pages main text plus references/appendix, max 12 pages total. Double-blind via OpenReview. Abstracts due October 18. Notification January 4, 2027; final versions January 31, 2027. Published in the main proceedings.

name_full: The Web Conference 2027 (Industry Showcase)
notes: Interactive showcases of systems developed in industrial environments. Submit a ~500-word abstract plus a one-minute showcase video and on-site presenter details. Notification January 4, 2027.

name_full: The Web Conference 2027 (Resource Track)
notes: Resource contributions (creation and usage of resources). Max 4 pages including references. Single-blind review by the Resource Committee. Notification January 20, 2027; camera-ready February 17, 2027. Included in the Companion Proceedings.

name_full: The Web Conference 2027 (PhD Symposium)
notes: PhD students at any stage. Single-author, non-anonymous, max 4 pages incl. references (ACM double-column) via OpenReview. Notification February 1, 2027; final version February 14, 2027. Accepted papers can be included in the Companion Proceedings (opt-out available).

name_full: ACM International Conference on Web Search and Data Mining (Tutorial Proposals)
notes: Tutorial proposals: up to 1-page cover sheet + 3-page extended abstract. Notification November 5, 2026. Tutorial day February 15, 2027 (tentative).

name_full: ACM International Conference on Web Search and Data Mining (Workshop Proposals)
notes: Workshop proposals. Notification October 15, 2026. Workshop day February 19, 2027. Workshop paper submissions due by November 30, 2026 (organizers set exact dates); accepted workshop papers appear in the Companion Proceedings unless organizers opt out.

name_full: ACM International Conference on Web Search and Data Mining (Demonstrations)
notes: Demo papers, max 4 pages including references and appendices. Single-blind review. Notification November 21, 2026; camera-ready December 16, 2026. Archival in the WSDM 2027 proceedings; in-person presentation required.

name_full: ACM International Conference on Web Search and Data Mining (WSDM Cup Proposals)
notes: Proposals to organize a WSDM Cup challenge (problem, data, metrics, timeline) via CMT. Notification October 27, 2026 (tentative). Cup runs November 16, 2026-February 5, 2027.

name_full: ACM International Conference on Web Search and Data Mining (Industry Day Talks)
notes: Talk proposals from industry teams and academia-industry collaborations with deployment experience. Max 2 pages incl. references (ACM sigconf). Notification November 27, 2026. Accepted authors may submit a camera-ready abstract for the proceedings; in-person presentation required.

name_full: ACM International Conference on Web Search and Data Mining (Doctoral Consortium)
notes: For PhD students who have completed (or are close to) a thesis proposal. 3-page research statement incl. references, plus benefits statement and CV appendices. Notification December 2, 2026. Consortium held February 15, 2027. Accepted students may publish a 3-page extended abstract in the proceedings; travel support available via sponsors such as ACM SIGIR.

name_full: ACM International Conference on Web Search and Data Mining (WSDM Day Presentations)
notes: WSDM Day on "State of Data Mining & Web Search in the Agentic AI Era" (February 19, 2027). 2-page extended abstract (ACM sigconf), single-blind via CMT; ongoing/unpublished work and papers under review welcome. Oral or poster presentation. Notification December 21, 2026; camera-ready December 31, 2026.

name_full: International Communication Association Conference (Pre-/Postconference Proposals)
notes: Proposals to organize a pre- or postconference at the 77th annual conference, submitted via the online form (proposals sent by email are not accepted). Submission period August 7-28, 2026; deadline 12:00 noon EDT. Up to 30 preconferences (on-site preconferences only on Thursday, June 3) and 10 postconferences accepted. Acceptance letters early September 2026; accepted events must enter details into ScholarOne by November 2, 2026.

name_full: International School and Conference on Network Science
notes: Call for satellite proposals. Satellites run May 17-18, 2027 (until midday May 18). Full-day satellites only on Monday May 17; half-day otherwise. Submit a single PDF (title, summary of topic/aims, organisers with affiliations, half/full-day format and structure, preliminary speaker list) by email to satellites.netsci@tu-dresden.de. Notification December 15, 2026.

name_full: Conference on Complex Systems
notes: Hosted by Wrocław University of Science and Technology (Congress Center, building D-20). yrCSS warm-up for young scientists September 17-18. Official website is live but no call for abstracts or satellites has been published yet; the 2026 abstract deadline was in May, so expect a call in spring 2027.

name_full: Communication Horizons Conference 2027
notes: Theme: The Future of Influence: People, Platforms, and Artificial Intelligence. 500-word extended abstracts (excluding title page, references, tables, figures). Empirical submissions must have completed data collection and include preliminary results. Accepted work is invited as a research presentation or poster. Decisions March 15, 2027. Submission site TBA; held at the UC Davis Student Community Center.

name_full: Search Engines and Society Annual Conference 2027 (Presentations)
notes: Extended abstract, max 800 words (excluding references), APA style, PDF via EasyChair. Ongoing and work-in-progress research welcome. Accepted abstracts are made freely available in a Book of Abstracts after the conference. Hosted at Lund University; organized by the Search Engines and Society Network (SEASON). Notification date not yet announced.

name_full: Search Engines and Society Annual Conference 2027 (Interactive Sessions)
notes: Panels, workshops, and experimental formats of 60-180 minutes. Proposal max 1000 words (excluding references) covering purpose, abstract, and format; APA style, PDF via EasyChair. Notification date not yet announced.

name_full: Search Engines and Society Annual Conference 2027 (Posters)
notes: Poster abstract max 500 words (excluding references), APA style, PDF via EasyChair. Notification date not yet announced.

name_full: International Communication Association Conference (Blue Sky Workshops)
notes: Proposals for 75-minute Blue Sky Workshops (interactive, discussion-based sessions; not panels or lectures), submitted via the online proposal form. Same timeline as conference papers: September 1 to November 2, 2026 at 12:00 noon ET.

name_full: International Communication Association Conference (Journalism Studies Division PhD Colloquium)
notes: In-person preconference for PhD students in journalism studies, held at the University of Strathclyde the day before ICA 2027. Submit a 500-word abstract (excluding references) as PDF; deadline 11:59 pm AoE. Notification February 28, 2027; accepted participants submit a full or working paper (up to 8,000 words) by May 1, 2027.

name_full: International Conference on Computational Social Science
notes: 13th IC2S2, announced for Milan, Italy. Dates and call for abstracts not yet published; the 2026 edition's 2-page anonymized extended abstracts were due in early March (AoE), so expect a call around January 2027.

name_full: International Conference on Computational Social Science
notes: 13th IC2S2, announced for Milan, Italy. Tutorial call not yet published; the 2026 edition's tutorial proposals were due in early February.

name_full: Political Networks Conference 2027
notes: 20th Annual Political Networks Conference, hosted by Vanderbilt University. Dates and call for abstracts not yet announced (official site says 'date tba, details will follow'). APSA Political Networks Section conference. The 2026 abstract deadline was April 22, so expect a spring 2027 deadline.

name_full: Trust & Safety Research Conference 2027
notes: 6th annual conference, Stanford Tech Impact and Policy Center. Organizers say 2027 dates will be announced in spring 2027. Accepts research presentations, lightning talks, posters, and workshop proposals. 2026 cycle: call opened February 2, proposals due April 30, conference October 1-2.

name_full: International Workshop on Cyber Social Threats
notes: Expected to be co-located with ICWSM 2027 in Edinburgh (May 2027). ICWSM 2027 workshop proposals are due January 15, 2027 with notification March 15, 2027, so the CySoc 2027 call is not expected before mid-March 2027. Past editions accepted research (8-11 pp), position, short, and demo papers in AAAI format with a late-March deadline.

name_full: Computational Social Science Society of the Americas Conference
notes: CSS 2027 call not yet released. Location assumed Santa Fe (host every year since 2011 except virtual 2021). 2026 papers (3,000-5,000 words) were due July 22 after an extension from June 30; expect a call around March-April 2027.

name_full: Computational Social Science Society of the Americas Conference
notes: CSS 2027 call not yet released. Location assumed Santa Fe. 2026 extended abstracts were 1,000-2,000 words, due July 22.

name_full: Computational Social Science Society of the Americas Conference
notes: CSS 2027 call not yet released. Location assumed Santa Fe. 2026 posters required an ~800-word abstract, due July 22.
